# Alireza Rogni (AlirezaRg / Codeiish)

> Backend & systems engineer. Python, Flask, Django, Odoo/ERP integrations, Linux administration, and Claude Code CLI powered AI tooling. Builds backends that don't fall over and bridges hardware/systems that were never meant to talk to each other.

Alireza Rogni is a backend developer and Linux administrator, founder of Codeiish, based remotely and working worldwide. Core focus areas: Python backend services (Flask, Django), Odoo 18 / ERP integrations, biometric hardware bridges over WebSocket, Linux server administration (Debian, systemd, Nginx), and small AI-powered developer tools built on Claude Code CLI.

## Projects

- Rasco-Gosi — JARVIS-style desktop AI assistant using Claude Code CLI as its reasoning engine: https://github.com/AlirezaRg/Rasco-Gosi
- Ex-Changes-Code (EX-CHANGE) — AI-powered code translator across 13 programming languages via Claude Code CLI: https://github.com/AlirezaRg/Ex-Changes-Code
- code-analysis (CODEANALYSIS) — AI-powered codebase search and file explainer: https://github.com/AlirezaRg/code-analysis
- Flask + Odoo Attendance Bridge — Flask middleware connecting ST-Face biometric devices to Odoo 18 over WebSocket
- Omid Market — Full Django e-commerce app with ZarinPal payments and RTL support
- hand-mouse-control — Webcam hand-tracking mouse control via MediaPipe: https://github.com/AlirezaRg/hand-mouse-control
- cv-playground — Real-time face detection/recognition with InsightFace and ArcFace: https://github.com/AlirezaRg/cv-playground
- pdf-insurance-to-excel — Converts Iranian insurance PDF reports to Excel, with OCR: https://github.com/AlirezaRg/pdf-insurance-to-excel
